fields.name: High Return on Equity
fields.description: Checks if Return on Equity is strictly greater than 15%.

fields.name: Low Debt to Equity
fields.description: Checks if Debt to Equity ratio is less than 0.5.

fields.name: Strong Revenue Growth
fields.description: Checks if year-over-year revenue growth is greater than 10%.

fields.name: Healthy Operating Margin
fields.description: Checks if the operating margin is greater than 15%.

fields.name: Positive Free Cash Flow
fields.description: Checks if the free cash flow is strictly positive.

fields.name: Reasonable Valuation (P/E)
fields.description: Checks if the Price to Earnings ratio is less than 30.
